we present pSearch: a decentralized, non-flooding, P2P information-retrieval system that distributes document indices through P2P network using LSI and achieves performance comparable to centralized IR system.

pSearch is a novel, decentralized non-floody information retrieval system that is capable of achieving comparable performance to centralized systems by accessing only a small number (less than 20) of nodes and transmitting only a small amount of data during search.
pSearch is a scalable, efficient and accurate P2P information search system.
pSearch can reduce the search cost by a large margin without compromising the quality of the search results.

we have developed a decentralized P2P information search system that can achieve performance comparable with centralized information retrieval systems.

semantic information can be used to reduce the search cost in decentralized systems, and the search performance can be further improved by using techniques to guide the search.
